subject: design/skill-command-prefix-v1
statement: Deliver the namespace cut as a **per-skill live rewrite train** plus a **closing conformance test**: each skill PR renames that skill to `pyxis-<basename>` and rewrites every allowed live occurrence of its identity (structural forms everywhere live; **all** skill-basename references under the live system tree); regenerates harness skill views via existing converge reconcile (never hand-edit generated views); hard-cuts with no aliases. The closing PR lands a **scripts-test / Go-payload conformance test** (help-purity pattern) that refuses non-`pyxis-*` skill directories/`name:` pairs, and confirms the Argus/`/pyxis-argus` glossary split. No docgate skill-prefix check. (design-brainstorm:skill-command-prefix-tech-design#D-1…#D-5)
